parsed.rationale: The 'article-api - /extract' API directly extracts metadata including content type from a given URL, matching the subtask to retrieve the content type of a file from the source URL. It requires a 'url' parameter which can be bound from the 'source_url' input. Other APIs either focus on screenshots, downloads, or unrelated functions.
